contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' ($13,894.23) on the p7 Summary Page, equal to the HANDWRITTEN 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' printed on p3 (13,894.23) and to the sum of the two Schedule A sheets' own printed page subtotals (5350 + 8,544.23)
contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets, each gated on its OWN printed page subtotal first (§L2). p2: 15 rows sum to 500 + 100 + 300 + 50 + 2000 + 500 + 100 + 250 + 100 + 250 + 250 + 300 + 50 + 500 + 100 = 5,350.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 5350'. p3: 8 rows sum to 100 + 5000 + 100 + 100 + 200 + 40 + 3000 + 4.23 = 8,544.23 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 8,544.23'. Multi-sheet total 5,350.00 + 8,544.23 = 13,894.23 = the grand-total footer on p3 = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. Box C YTD also prints 13,894.23 and is not summed as an increment. p2's grand-total footer prints the superseded typed '5350' STRUCK THROUGH with '$13,894.23' handwritten and initialled 'SMB' — the handwritten correction over the struck typed value GOVERNS and agrees with p3's footer and with Box B. THE COUNTY'S REDACTION PASS TOUCHES NO FIGURE: every bar on this copy falls in the Address column (and on the cover), so the amount column and both footers are entirely legible and the side closes exactly. Ladder: F = A + B = 0 + 13,894.23 and close = F - D = 13,894.23 - 3,849.95 = 10,044.28, exactly as printed.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' ($3,849.95) on the p7 Summary Page, equal to the HANDWRITTEN 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' printed on p5 and p6 (3,849.95) and to the sum of the three Schedule B sheets' own printed page subtotals (2,458.67 + 810.64 + 580.64)
expenditures.detail: THREE Schedule B sheets, each gated on its own printed page subtotal (§L2). p4: 15 rows sum to 2,458.67 = its printed subtotal; p5: 15 rows sum to 810.64 = its printed subtotal; p6: 9 rows sum to 580.64 = its printed subtotal; 2,458.67 + 810.64 + 580.64 = 3,849.95 = the handwritten grand-total footer on p5 and p6 = the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box D. Box E YTD also prints 3,849.95 and is never summed. p4's typed grand-total footer prints the superseded '2458.67' struck through with '$3,849.95' handwritten and initialled 'SMB'; the handwritten correction governs. No Schedule B page carries any redaction bar at all.

Row-level evidence, not total-level: same report type ticked ('Seven days preceding the General Election'), same amendment answer ('No'), same typed cover, same dotloop banners (dtlp.us/hJgj-FYBE-0IZc on pp1/3 and dtlp.us/vICx-xBiz-HQPm on pp2/4), same Date of Report 10/28/2024, same clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 30 2024, same seven-page shape with the same three mastheads, and EVERY ledger line identical — all 23 contribution rows and all 39 expenditure rows, the same five page subtotals (5350 / 8,544.23 / 2,458.67 / 810.64 / 580.64), the same struck typed grand totals with the same 'SMB' corrections, and the same six summary boxes. The grids even measure identically to the hundredth of a percent, so the redaction was applied to the SAME digital file rather than to a re-scan. THE ONLY DIFFERENCES ARE THE COUNTY'S BLACK BARS, and they are consequential for the donor layer: on the cover the candidate's street address, phone number and signature are barred (all in the clear on 00c19030), and on p2 the county blacked out each donor's street — but NOT UNIFORMLY. On rows 1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 14 and 15 the bar stops short and the city, state and zip survive; on rows 2, 3, 5, 9, 12 and 13 THE BAR COVERS THE CITY TOO, leaving only the state and zip. Those six rows therefore carry an honestly BLANK donor_city on this record — the city was NOT carried across from the unredacted sibling, because a value may come only from the row's own cell on its own document (§C3 / §L6, and the same discipline as the riverton mislabeled-source precedent). This is the practical demonstration of §K2's point that a redaction pass WITHHOLDS disclosure the other copy makes, and of §I1's 'judge redaction from the page, per cell': p3, p4, p5 and p6 carry no bar at all, so the same filing is redacted on one Schedule A sheet and untouched on the other. Independent agreement with 00c19030 on all 62 amounts, all five page subtotals and both grand totals is CORROBORATION and is recorded on every row; the geometry was re-measured and re-proved on this PDF (§K1).
